# Vortex Studio documentation

Complete reference for the Vortex Studio Luau runtime and recovered Luau sources.

## Getting started

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#introduction

### Introduction

Vortex Studio runs Luau scripts against its scene and multiplayer runtime.

#### Overview

The runtime exposes a small Roblox-style API: Instances, engine services, Vector3, Color3, CFrame, signals, tasks, tweens, and remotes. If an API is not listed here, assume this build does not expose it.

#### A first script

Services are reached through game:GetService. Instances use the same method-call syntax as ordinary Luau userdata.

```luau
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local platform = Workspace:WaitForChild("Platform")

platform.Anchored = true
platform.Position = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
platform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(92, 170, 255)
```

#### Version scope

This reference covers Vortex Studio v0.3.4. Later builds may add or change members.

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#execution-model

### Execution model

Scripts run as cooperative Luau coroutines hosted by the Vortex engine.

#### Scheduling

A script keeps control until it returns or yields. task.wait, Signal:Wait, and remote invokes resume after their timer, signal, or response is ready.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `task.wait(seconds?: number): number?` | Yield for approximately the requested duration. The default is 0 seconds. |
| `Signal:Wait(): ...any` | Suspend until the next signal fire and return its arguments. |

```luau
local button = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("Button")
local touchingPart = button.Touched:Wait()

button:SetAttribute("PressedBy", touchingPart.Name)
task.wait(0.25)
button:SetAttribute("PressedBy", nil)
```

#### Script contexts

Script runs on the server, LocalScript runs on a client, and ModuleScript contains reusable Luau code. Remote direction and selected gameplay state are enforced by the native host.

#### Heartbeat

RunService.Heartbeat fires once per engine update and passes the elapsed time in seconds. TweenService also advances its active tweens from this signal.

```luau
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local platform = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("Platform")

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    platform.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, deltaTime, 0)
end)
```

## Core libraries

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#language-environment

### Language environment

Built-ins and standard libraries available to Vortex scripts.

#### Built-ins

Use ordinary Luau primitives for guards, iteration, tables, and error handling.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `type / typeof / tostring / tonumber / error` | Type inspection, conversion, and errors. |
| `print(...any)` | Write a line to the Studio Luau console. |
| `warn(...any)` | Write a warning line to the Studio Luau console. |
| `pairs / ipairs` | Table iteration. |
| `setmetatable` | Metatable assignment used by every Vortex datatype. |
| `pcall` | Protected calls used by tweens and server invokes. |

#### Standard libraries

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `math` | Numeric functions used by Vector3, CFrame, and all easing implementations. |
| `string` | Formatting and pattern matching. |
| `table` | pack, unpack, insert, remove, and ordinary table operations. |
| `coroutine` | create, resume, yield, and status; integrated with the host scheduler. |

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#task-library

### task library

Functions for starting, delaying, and yielding Luau coroutines.

#### Functions

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `task.wait(seconds?: number): number?` | Yield the current coroutine. Defaults to 0. |
| `task.spawn(fn: function, ...any): thread` | Create or resume a coroutine immediately. |
| `task.delay(seconds: number, fn: function, ...any): thread` | Schedule a coroutine through the native host after a delay. |
| `task.defer(fn: function, ...any): thread` | Equivalent to task.delay(0, fn, ...). |

```luau
local status = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RoundStatus")

task.delay(10, function()
    status.Value = "Round over"
end)
```

#### Compatibility aliases

The global wait, spawn, and delay functions forward to their task equivalents.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `wait(seconds?: number)` | Alias of task.wait. |
| `spawn(fn: function)` | Alias of task.spawn. |
| `delay(seconds: number, fn: function)` | Alias of task.delay. |

## Datatypes

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#vector3

### Vector3

A three-component vector used for positions, sizes, directions, and transforms.

#### Constructor and constants

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Vector3.new(x?: number, y?: number, z?: number): Vector3` | Construct a vector. Missing components default to 0. |
| `Vector3.zero` | Vector3.new(0, 0, 0). |
| `Vector3.one` | Vector3.new(1, 1, 1). |
| `Vector3.xAxis / yAxis / zAxis` | Positive unit basis vectors. |

#### Properties and methods

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `X / Y / Z: number` | Component properties. Lowercase x, y, and z are also stored on the value. |
| `Magnitude: number` | Euclidean vector length. |
| `Unit: Vector3` | Normalized vector. A zero vector returns Vector3.zero. |
| `vector:Dot(other: Vector3): number` | Dot product. |
| `vector:Cross(other: Vector3): Vector3` | Cross product. |
| `vector:Lerp(other: Vector3, alpha: number): Vector3` | Linear interpolation without clamping alpha. |

```luau
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local mover = Workspace:WaitForChild("Mover")
local target = Workspace:WaitForChild("Target")
local offset = target.Position - mover.Position

if offset.Magnitude > 0 then
    mover.Position += offset.Unit * math.min(offset.Magnitude, 5)
end
```

#### Operators

Vector3 supports +, -, unary -, and ==. Multiplication and division accept either a number or another Vector3 and apply component-wise when both operands are vectors.

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#color3

### Color3

A three-channel RGB color value.

#### Members

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Color3.new(r?: number, g?: number, b?: number): Color3` | Construct from normalized channel values. Missing channels default to 0. |
| `Color3.fromRGB(r: number, g: number, b: number): Color3` | Construct from 0-255 style channel values by dividing each value by 255. |
| `R / G / B: number` | Stored red, green, and blue channels. |
| `color:Lerp(other: Color3, alpha: number): Color3` | Linear interpolation without clamping alpha. |

```luau
local platform = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("Platform")
local safe = Color3.fromRGB(90, 190, 120)
local danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80)

platform.Color = safe:Lerp(danger, 0.35)
```

#### Operators

Color3 supports equality and string conversion.

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#cframe

### CFrame

A position and rotation in 3D space.

#### Constructors

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `CFrame.identity: CFrame` | Identity transform constant. |
| `CFrame.new(): CFrame` | Identity transform. |
| `CFrame.new(x: number, y: number, z: number): CFrame` | Translation-only transform. |
| `CFrame.new(position: Vector3): CFrame` | Translation from a vector. |
| `CFrame.new(at: Vector3, lookAt: Vector3, up?: Vector3): CFrame` | Look-at transform. |
| `CFrame.new(x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw): CFrame` | Quaternion transform. |
| `CFrame.new(x, y, z, r00, ..., r22): CFrame` | Transform from a 3x3 rotation matrix. |
| `CFrame.fromMatrix(position, right, up, back?): CFrame` | Construct from basis vectors. The final axis is computed when omitted. |
| `CFrame.lookAt(at, target, up?): CFrame` | Orient the negative Z axis toward target. |
| `CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ(rx, ry, rz): CFrame` | XYZ Euler rotation. CFrame.Angles is an alias. |
| `CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(rx, ry, rz): CFrame` | YXZ Euler rotation. fromOrientation is an alias. |
| `CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, angle): CFrame` | Axis-angle rotation. |

```luau
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local turret = Workspace:WaitForChild("Turret")
local target = Workspace:WaitForChild("Target")

turret.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(turret.Position, target.Position)
```

#### Properties

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Position / p: Vector3` | Translation component. |
| `X / Y / Z: number` | Translation components. |
| `LookVector / RightVector / UpVector: Vector3` | World-space facing basis vectors. |
| `XVector / YVector / ZVector: Vector3` | Rotation matrix basis vectors. |
| `Rotation: CFrame` | Rotation component with its translation reset to zero. |

#### Methods

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cf:Inverse(): CFrame` | Inverse transform. |
| `cf:ToWorldSpace(other: CFrame): CFrame` | Compose cf * other. |
| `cf:ToObjectSpace(other: CFrame): CFrame` | Compose cf:Inverse() * other. |
| `cf:PointToWorldSpace(point: Vector3): Vector3` | Transform a point with translation. |
| `cf:PointToObjectSpace(point: Vector3): Vector3` | Inverse-transform a point. |
| `cf:VectorToWorldSpace(vector: Vector3): Vector3` | Rotate a vector without translation. |
| `cf:VectorToObjectSpace(vector: Vector3): Vector3` | Inverse-rotate a vector without translation. |
| `cf:GetComponents(): 12 numbers` | Return position followed by the 3x3 rotation matrix. components is an alias. |
| `cf:ToEulerAnglesXYZ(): number, number, number` | Extract XYZ Euler angles. toEulerAnglesXYZ is an alias. |
| `cf:ToEulerAnglesYXZ(): number, number, number` | Extract YXZ Euler angles. ToOrientation and toEulerAnglesYXZ are aliases. |
| `cf:Lerp(goal: CFrame, alpha: number): CFrame` | Interpolate position and orientation using the shortest quaternion path. |

```luau
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local platform = Workspace:WaitForChild("Platform")
local marker = Workspace:WaitForChild("Marker")

marker.CFrame = platform.CFrame:ToWorldSpace(CFrame.new(0, 2, 0))
```

#### Operators

CFrame multiplication composes transforms or transforms a Vector3 point. Adding or subtracting a Vector3 offsets the translation. Equality compares all stored position and quaternion components.

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#enum

### Enum

Named integer values used by input, tweening, materials, and playback state.

#### Enum types

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Enum.Material` | Smooth=1, Plastic=2, Wood=3, Metal=4, Grass=5, Ice=6, Paint=7. |
| `Enum.NormalId` | Right=0, Top=1, Back=2, Left=3, Bottom=4, Front=5. |
| `Enum.UserInputType` | MouseButton1=0, MouseButton2=1, MouseButton3=2, MouseWheel=3, MouseMovement=4, Touch=7, Keyboard=8, Focus=9, Gamepad1=12, None=19. |
| `Enum.EasingStyle` | Linear=0, Sine=1, Back=2, Quad=3, Quart=4, Quint=5, Bounce=6, Elastic=7, Exponential=8, Circular=9, Cubic=10. |
| `Enum.EasingDirection` | In=0, Out=1, InOut=2. |
| `Enum.PlaybackState` | Begin=0, Delayed=1, Playing=2, Paused=3, Completed=4, Cancelled=5. |

#### EnumType and EnumItem

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `EnumType:GetEnumItems(): {EnumItem}` | Return a new array containing the type's items. |
| `EnumType:FromName(name: string): EnumItem?` | Look up an item by name. |
| `EnumType:FromValue(value: number): EnumItem?` | Look up an item by numeric value. |
| `EnumItem.Name: string` | Item name. |
| `EnumItem.Value: number` | Numeric value. |
| `EnumItem.EnumType: EnumType` | Owning enum type. |

#### KeyCode values

KeyCode includes Backspace, Tab, Return, Escape, Space, punctuation keys, Zero-Nine, A-Z, Delete, arrow keys, left/right Shift, Control, Alt and Super, plus F1-F12. Letter and digit values use their ASCII codes; arrows are 17-20; function keys are 265-276.

## Runtime

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#signals

### Signal

A synchronous event primitive with connections, one-shot handlers, and coroutine waiting.

#### Members

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Signal.new(name?: string): Signal` | Create a signal. |
| `signal:Connect(fn: function): Connection` | Register a handler. connect is an alias. |
| `signal:Once(fn: function): Connection` | Register a handler that disconnects before its first call. |
| `signal:Wait(): ...any` | Yield until the next Fire and return its arguments. |
| `signal:Fire(...any)` | Call a snapshot of connected handlers and resume current waiters. fire is an alias. |
| `connection:Disconnect()` | Disable the connection. disconnect is an alias. |

```luau
local roundChanged = Signal.new("RoundChanged")

roundChanged:Connect(function(roundNumber)
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):SetAttribute("Round", roundNumber)
end)

roundChanged:Fire(2)
```

> [!NOTE]
> A Signal accepts at most 512 connected handlers.

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#tweening

### Tweening

TweenService interpolates numeric and Lerp-capable properties over Heartbeat updates.

#### TweenInfo

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `TweenInfo.new(time?, style?, direction?, repeatCount?, reverses?, delayTime?): TweenInfo` | Defaults: 1 second, Quad, Out, 0 repeats, no reverse, 0 delay. |
| `Time / EasingStyle / EasingDirection` | Duration and easing fields. |
| `RepeatCount / Reverses / DelayTime` | Looping and delay fields. |

#### Tween

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `TweenService:Create(instance, info, goals): Tween` | Capture the target and goal property map. |
| `tween:Play()` | Begin or resume playback. |
| `tween:Pause()` | Pause an active tween. |
| `tween:Cancel()` | Stop playback and fire Completed with Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled. |
| `tween.Completed: Signal` | Fires with the final PlaybackState. |
| `tween.PlaybackState: EnumItem` | Current state. |

```luau
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local door = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("Door")
local openPosition = door.Position + Vector3.new(0, door.Size.Y, 0)
local tween = TweenService:Create(
    door,
    TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
    { Position = openPosition }
)

tween:Play()
```

> [!NOTE]
> The runtime allows up to 256 active tweens. A target whose Parent becomes nil is removed.

## Engine API

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#services

### Services

Singleton engine objects returned by game:GetService(name).

#### Lookup

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `game:GetService(name: string): Instance` | Return the named service or raise an error for an invalid service. |

#### Available services

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Workspace` | Scene root and spatial Instance hierarchy. |
| `Players` | Player collection and LocalPlayer. |
| `RunService` | Execution context and Heartbeat. |
| `ReplicatedStorage` | Shared Instance container. |
| `StarterPlayerScripts` | Client script template container. |
| `ServerScriptService` | Server-only script container. |
| `Debris` | Delayed destruction. |
| `TweenService` | Property tween creation. |
| `UserInputService` | Client input queries. Unavailable on the server. |

#### Service-specific members

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Players.LocalPlayer: Player?` | The local client's Player. |
| `Debris:AddItem(item: Instance, lifetime?: number)` | Call Destroy after lifetime seconds; defaults to 10. |
| `Debris:SetMaxItems()` | Compatibility no-op. |
| `RunService.Heartbeat: Signal` | Frame update signal. |
| `TweenService:Create(instance, info, goals): Tween` | Create a Tween. |

```luau
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local spark = Instance.new("PointLight")

spark.Parent = Workspace:WaitForChild("Impact")
Debris:AddItem(spark, 0.15)
```

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#instance

### Instance

The base object model for services, scene objects, scripts, values, and network endpoints.

#### Hierarchy

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Name: string` | Instance name. |
| `ClassName: string` | Read-only class name. |
| `Parent: Instance?` | Parent in the Instance tree. Assign an Instance or nil. |
| `instance:GetChildren(): {Instance}` | Direct children. |
| `instance:GetDescendants(): {Instance}` | All descendants. |
| `instance:FindFirstChild(name: string): Instance?` | Find a direct child by name. |
| `instance:WaitForChild(name: string, timeout?: number): Instance?` | Poll every 0.05 seconds until found or timed out. |
| `instance:FindFirstChildOfClass(className: string): Instance?` | Find a direct child by class. |
| `instance:IsA(className: string): boolean` | Test class identity/ancestry. |

```luau
local effects = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Effects")

for _, item in ipairs(effects:GetDescendants()) do
    if item:IsA("Part") then
        item.Transparency = 0.5
    end
end
```

#### Lifecycle

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Instance.new(className: string): Instance` | Construct a supported class. See Instance classes for the supported constructor targets. |
| `instance:Destroy()` | Destroy the Instance. |
| `instance:Clone(): Instance` | Clone supported Instances; unsupported roots raise an error. |

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local template = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Explosion")
local effect = template:Clone()

effect.Parent = Workspace
task.delay(2, function()
    effect:Destroy()
end)
```

#### Properties and attributes

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property: string): Signal` | Signal for a named property. |
| `instance:SetAttribute(name: string, value: boolean \| number \| string \| nil)` | Set or remove an attribute. |
| `instance:GetAttribute(name: string): boolean \| number \| string \| nil` | Read one attribute. |
| `instance:GetAttributes(): {[string]: boolean \| number \| string}` | Return current attributes. |
| `instance:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name: string): Signal` | Signal for one attribute. |

```luau
local objective = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("Objective")

objective:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Captured"):Connect(function()
    objective.Color = objective:GetAttribute("Captured")
        and Color3.fromRGB(90, 190, 120)
        or Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80)
end)
```

> [!NOTE]
> Attribute values are limited to nil, boolean, number, or string.

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#classes

### Instance classes

Classes recognized by the native Instance bridge.

#### Scene and containers

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Workspace` | Spatial scene root. |
| `ReplicatedStorage` | Replicated object container. |
| `StarterPlayerScripts` | Client script template container. |
| `ServerScriptService` | Server script container. |
| `Model` | Group of scene Instances. |
| `Folder` | Generic hierarchy container. |

#### World objects

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Part` | 3D part with Position, Rotation/Orientation, CFrame, Size, Color, Transparency, Anchored, CanCollide, CastShadow, Touched, and TouchEnded. |
| `PointLight` | Point light Instance. |
| `SpotLight` | Directional spot light Instance. |
| `Humanoid` | Character health object with Health, HealthChanged, and Died. Health writes are server-authoritative. |
| `HumanoidRootPart` | Character root part class. |

```luau
local lamp = Instance.new("Part")
lamp.Name = "Lamp"
lamp.Anchored = true
lamp.Position = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
lamp.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")

local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
light.Parent = lamp
```

#### Part members

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Position: Vector3` | World position. |
| `Rotation / Orientation: Vector3` | Euler rotation. |
| `CFrame: CFrame` | Full world transform. |
| `Size: Vector3` | Part dimensions. |
| `Color: Color3` | Surface color. |
| `Transparency: number` | Transparency value; must be a finite number. |
| `Anchored / CanCollide / CastShadow: boolean` | Physics and rendering flags. |
| `Touched / TouchEnded: Signal` | Collision begin/end signals. |

#### Scripts, networking, and values

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Script / LocalScript / ModuleScript` | Server, client, and reusable Luau script containers. |
| `RemoteEvent / RemoteFunction` | Client/server messaging endpoints. |
| `BindableEvent` | Local event endpoint. |
| `IntValue.Value: number` | Stored numeric value. |
| `StringValue.Value: string` | Stored text value. |
| `Player.Character: Model?` | The player's current character. |
| `Humanoid.Health: number` | Character health. Writes are server-authoritative. |

```luau
local score = Instance.new("IntValue")
score.Name = "Score"
score.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

score:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
    score:SetAttribute("MilestoneReached", score.Value >= 100)
end)
```

> [!NOTE]
> Instance.new supports Part, Model, Folder, PointLight, SpotLight, LocalScript, Script, ModuleScript, RemoteEvent, BindableEvent, RemoteFunction, IntValue, and StringValue. Engine-owned roots and character objects are not constructor targets.

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#events-input

### Events and input

Signals emitted by Instances, gameplay state, and the client input service.

#### Common events

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Part.Touched: Signal` | A collision contact began. |
| `Part.TouchEnded: Signal` | A collision contact ended. |
| `Humanoid.HealthChanged: Signal` | Health changed. |
| `Humanoid.Died: Signal` | Health reached the death state. |

```luau
local pad = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("DamagePad")
local idle = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80)

pad.Touched:Connect(function()
    pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 90)
end)

pad.TouchEnded:Connect(function()
    pad.Color = idle
end)
```

#### UserInputService

UserInputService is client-only. Use the signals for edges and IsKeyDown when you need current state.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `UserInputService.InputBegan: Signal` | Fires when a client input begins. |
| `UserInputService.InputEnded: Signal` | Fires when a client input ends. |
| `UserInputService:IsKeyDown(keyCode: Enum.KeyCode): boolean` | Return whether a keyboard key is currently held. |

```luau
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local shiftHeld = false

local function updateShift()
    local isDown = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
    if isDown == shiftHeld then
        return
    end

    shiftHeld = isDown
    print(isDown and "Shift pressed" or "Shift released")
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(updateShift)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(updateShift)
```

## Networking

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#networking

### Remotes

RemoteEvent sends messages between client and server. RemoteFunction sends a request and waits for a response.

#### RemoteEvent

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `remote:FireServer(...any)` | Client -> server. Calling from a server script raises an error. |
| `remote:FireClient(playerOrUserId, ...any)` | Server -> one client. Calling from a client script raises an error. |
| `remote:FireAllClients(...any)` | Server -> every client. Calling from a client script raises an error. |

##### LocalScript

```luau
-- LocalScript
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("GameEvent")

if remote then
    remote:FireServer("Ready")
end
```

##### Script

```luau
-- Script
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("GameEvent")

if remote then
    remote:FireAllClients("RoundStarted", 90)
end
```

#### RemoteFunction

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `remote:InvokeServer(...any): ...any` | Client -> server request that yields for a response. |
| `remote.OnServerInvoke: function?` | Server callback used to produce the response. |

##### Script

```luau
-- Script
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ItemPrice")
local prices = { sword = 250, shield = 175 }

if remote then
    remote.OnServerInvoke = function(itemId)
        return prices[itemId]
    end
end
```

##### LocalScript

```luau
-- LocalScript
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ItemPrice")

if remote then
    local price = remote:InvokeServer("sword")
    if price then
        script:SetAttribute("DisplayedPrice", price)
    end
end
```

> [!NOTE]
> InvokeServer is client-only and has a per-frame queue guard.

#### Serializable values

Remote payloads support primitive values, Vector3, Color3, lists, and maps. Keys must use supported primitive key types, and nested containers have a depth limit. Instances and CFrame values are rejected by this build.

##### LocalScript

```luau
-- LocalScript
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("GameEvent")

if remote then
    remote:FireServer({
        action = "Move",
        position = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
        color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80),
    })
end
```

> [!NOTE]
> Do not send Instances or CFrames through remotes. Send identifiers and numeric/vector data instead.

#### Channel helpers

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `FireServer(channel: string, ...any)` | Low-level client channel helper. |
| `OnRemoteEvent(channel: string, fn: function): Connection` | Connect to `RemoteEvent.<channel>`. |

##### LocalScript

```luau
-- LocalScript
FireServer("Chat", "hello")
```

##### Script

```luau
-- Script
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

OnRemoteEvent("Chat", function(message)
    if type(message) == "string" then
        ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("LastChatMessage", message)
    end
end)
```

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#authority

### Authority rules

The server owns remote direction and multiplayer character state.

#### Client and server checks

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `FireServer / InvokeServer` | Client scripts only. |
| `FireClient / FireAllClients` | Server scripts only. |
| `UserInputService` | Unavailable to server scripts. |
| `Humanoid.Health writes` | Read-only from LocalScript; health is server-authoritative. |
| `Character state writes` | Read-only from LocalScript where guarded; character state is server-authoritative. |

#### Pattern

Have the client request an action, validate it on the server, then let the server change authoritative state and notify clients.

##### LocalScript

```luau
-- LocalScript
local targetId = "training-dummy"
FireServer("Attack", targetId)
```

##### Script

```luau
-- Script
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local allowedTargets = {
    ["training-dummy"] = true,
}

OnRemoteEvent("Attack", function(targetId)
    if type(targetId) ~= "string" or not allowedTargets[targetId] then
        return
    end

    local target = Workspace:FindFirstChild(targetId)
    if not target or not target:IsA("Part") then
        return
    end

    target:SetAttribute("LastHit", true)
end)
```

## Reference

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#limits

### Runtime limits

Hard guards enforced by the embedded runtime and native host.

#### Limits

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `128 KiB Studio source limit` | The Studio Luau editor rejects larger snippets before queueing them. |
| `32 MiB Studio executor memory limit` | The standalone Studio executor sets this limit when it creates its Luau state. |
| `2 second Studio executor deadline` | The standalone executor stops snippets that overrun its native bounded call deadline. |
| `256 Studio console entries` | The console keeps the newest output records. |
| `4096 bytes per Studio console line` | Long print, warn, and error lines are clipped for display. |
| `512 Signal handlers` | Maximum connected handlers on one Signal. |
| `256 active tweens` | Maximum concurrent tweens managed by TweenService. |
| `512 RemoteEvent fires per frame` | Per-script/frame remote fire guard. |
| `50,000 property changes per frame` | Per-script/frame property mutation guard. |
| `Bounded remote nesting` | Deeply nested list/map payloads are rejected. |
| `Bounded pending task threads` | The host rejects scripts that accumulate too many pending scheduled threads. |

#### Practical guidance

Reuse connections, batch state changes, cancel unused tweens, and keep remote payloads shallow. Runtime limits are safety ceilings, not targets.

```luau
-- LocalScript
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local sensor = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("Sensor")
local pending = {}

sensor.Touched:Connect(function(part)
    table.insert(pending, part.Name)
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if #pending > 0 then
        FireServer("SensorTouches", pending)
        pending = {}
    end
end)
```

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#studio-executor

### Studio executor

The Studio Luau panel runs snippets through the same Vortex native runtime, with console capture and editor limits around it.

#### Running snippets

Studio queues one snippet at a time for the next Vortex main tick. If the runtime is not ready, the queued snippet waits for the bootstrap step first.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Run` | Queue the current editor tab for execution. |
| `Ctrl+Enter` | Run the active editor tab from the source editor. |
| `8 editor tabs` | Maximum number of open Luau documents in the Studio panel. |

#### Console output

print and warn are captured by the Studio console. Runtime errors are captured as error entries.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `print(...any)` | Joins values with tabs and stores a print entry. |
| `warn(...any)` | Joins values with tabs and stores a warning entry. |
| `error(message: any)` | Stops the snippet and records the error text. |

```luau
print("Loaded", 3, "modules")
warn("Using fallback configuration")
error("Startup check failed")
```

#### Snippet limits

The Studio executor is meant for short inspection and tooling snippets. Larger gameplay code still belongs in Script, LocalScript, or ModuleScript instances.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Source: 128 KiB` | The editor trims input at the UTF-8 boundary when a tab grows past the source limit. |
| `Memory: 32 MiB` | The executor configures this memory limit on the Luau state it creates. |
| `Deadline: 2 seconds` | A bounded native call stops snippets that do not finish in time. |

Page: https://vortex.protonn.co.uk/#project-format

### .vrtx project format

VortexTool.dll writes versioned Vortex project files containing map data and V2 scripts.

#### Container

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Magic: VRTX` | Four-byte file signature. |
| `Version: 1` | Current container version. |
| `Payload: Zstandard` | Compressed project payload begins with the Zstandard frame magic. |

> [!NOTE]
> Project serialization is separate from the runtime remote-value codec.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Vector3` | Construction, arithmetic, fields, Dot, Cross, and Lerp. |
| `Color3` | Normalized RGB construction, equality, string conversion, and Lerp. |
| `CFrame` | Quaternion-backed transforms, constructors, fields, conversion methods, and operators. |
| `Enum` | Enum types, items, values, lookup methods, and validation. |

### Runtime prelude

The Luau layer behind scheduling, signals, tweening, and remote helpers.

#### Contents

This prelude implements task scheduling, Debris, Signal and Connection, RunService.Heartbeat, TweenInfo, TweenService, and channel-based remote helpers. Native host callbacks handle timing, reporting, and transport.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `task / Debris` | Coroutine scheduling and delayed cleanup. |
| `Signal / Connection` | Event connections, one-shot handlers, waiting, and dispatch. |
| `TweenInfo / TweenService` | Easing, playback state, repeats, reverses, delay, and completion. |
| `FireServer / OnRemoteEvent` | Low-level channel helpers backed by the native transport. |

## Recovered Luau sources

### VortexStudio_main_prelude.luau

```luau
Vector3 = {}
Vector3.__index = Vector3

function Vector3.new(x, y, z)
    return setmetatable({ x = x or 0, y = y or 0, z = z or 0 }, Vector3)
end

function Vector3.__add(a, b)
    return Vector3.new(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z)
end

function Vector3.__sub(a, b)
    return Vector3.new(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z)
end

function Vector3.__mul(a, b)
    if type(a) == "number" then
        return Vector3.new(a * b.x, a * b.y, a * b.z)
    end
    if type(b) == "number" then
        return Vector3.new(a.x * b, a.y * b, a.z * b)
    end
    return Vector3.new(a.x * b.x, a.y * b.y, a.z * b.z)
end

function Vector3.__div(a, b)
    if type(b) == "number" then
        return Vector3.new(a.x / b, a.y / b, a.z / b)
    end
    return Vector3.new(a.x / b.x, a.y / b.y, a.z / b.z)
end

function Vector3.__unm(v)
    return Vector3.new(-v.x, -v.y, -v.z)
end

function Vector3.__eq(a, b)
    return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y and a.z == b.z
end

function Vector3.__tostring(v)
    return string.format("%.3f, %.3f, %.3f", v.x, v.y, v.z)
end

function Vector3:Dot(other)
    return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y + self.z * other.z
end

function Vector3:Cross(other)
    return Vector3.new(
        self.y * other.z - self.z * other.y,
        self.z * other.x - self.x * other.z,
        self.x * other.y - self.y * other.x
    )
end

function Vector3:Lerp(other, alpha)
    return self + (other - self) * alpha
end

Vector3.zero = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
Vector3.one = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
Vector3.xAxis = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
Vector3.yAxis = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
Vector3.zAxis = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)

local vector3_fields = {
    Magnitude = function(v)
        return math.sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z)
    end,
    Unit = function(v)
        local m = v.Magnitude
        if m == 0 then return Vector3.zero end
        return Vector3.new(v.x / m, v.y / m, v.z / m)
    end,
    X = function(v) return v.x end,
    Y = function(v) return v.y end,
    Z = function(v) return v.z end,
}

local vector3_methods = {}
for key, value in pairs(Vector3) do
    if type(value) == "function" then vector3_methods[key] = value end
end

function Vector3.__index(v, key)
    local field = vector3_fields[key]
    if field then return field(v) end
    return vector3_methods[key]
end

Color3 = {}
Color3.__index = Color3

function Color3.new(r, g, b)
    return setmetatable({ R = r or 0, G = g or 0, B = b or 0 }, Color3)
end

function Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
    return Color3.new((r or 0) / 255, (g or 0) / 255, (b or 0) / 255)
end

function Color3.__eq(a, b)
    return a.R == b.R and a.G == b.G and a.B == b.B
end

function Color3.__tostring(c)
    return string.format("%.3f, %.3f, %.3f", c.R, c.G, c.B)
end

function Color3:Lerp(other, alpha)
    return Color3.new(
        self.R + (other.R - self.R) * alpha,
        self.G + (other.G - self.G) * alpha,
        self.B + (other.B - self.B) * alpha
    )
end

CFrame = {}

local function qnorm(x, y, z, w)
    local m = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z + w * w)
    if m == 0 then return 0, 0, 0, 1 end
    return x / m, y / m, z / m, w / m
end

local function qmul(ax, ay, az, aw, bx, by, bz, bw)
    return
        aw * bx + ax * bw + ay * bz - az * by,
        aw * by - ax * bz + ay * bw + az * bx,
        aw * bz + ax * by - ay * bx + az * bw,
        aw * bw - ax * bx - ay * by - az * bz
end

local function qrot(qx, qy, qz, qw, vx, vy, vz)
    local tx = 2 * (qy * vz - qz * vy)
    local ty = 2 * (qz * vx - qx * vz)
    local tz = 2 * (qx * vy - qy * vx)
    return
        vx + qw * tx + (qy * tz - qz * ty),
        vy + qw * ty + (qz * tx - qx * tz),
        vz + qw * tz + (qx * ty - qy * tx)
end

local function axisq(ax, ay, az, angle)
    local h = angle * 0.5
    local s = math.sin(h)
    return ax * s, ay * s, az * s, math.cos(h)
end

local function qmat(x, y, z, w)
    local xx, yy, zz = x * x, y * y, z * z
    local xy, xz, yz = x * y, x * z, y * z
    local wx, wy, wz = w * x, w * y, w * z
    return
        1 - 2 * (yy + zz), 2 * (xy - wz),     2 * (xz + wy),
        2 * (xy + wz),     1 - 2 * (xx + zz), 2 * (yz - wx),
        2 * (xz - wy),     2 * (yz + wx),     1 - 2 * (xx + yy)
end

local function matq(r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22)
    local tr = r00 + r11 + r22
    if tr > 0 then
        local s = math.sqrt(tr + 1.0) * 2
        return (r21 - r12) / s, (r02 - r20) / s, (r10 - r01) / s, 0.25 * s
    elseif r00 > r11 and r00 > r22 then
        local s = math.sqrt(1.0 + r00 - r11 - r22) * 2
        return 0.25 * s, (r01 + r10) / s, (r02 + r20) / s, (r21 - r12) / s
    elseif r11 > r22 then
        local s = math.sqrt(1.0 + r11 - r00 - r22) * 2
        return (r01 + r10) / s, 0.25 * s, (r12 + r21) / s, (r02 - r20) / s
    else
        local s = math.sqrt(1.0 + r22 - r00 - r11) * 2
        return (r02 + r20) / s, (r12 + r21) / s, 0.25 * s, (r10 - r01) / s
    end
end

local function newRaw(x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw)
    qx, qy, qz, qw = qnorm(qx, qy, qz, qw)
    return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y, z = z, qx = qx, qy = qy, qz = qz, qw = qw }, CFrame)
end

function CFrame.fromMatrix(pos, vx, vy, vz)
    local qx, qy, qz, qw = matq(
        vx.x, vy.x, vz.x,
        vx.y, vy.y, vz.y,
        vx.z, vy.z, vz.z
    )
    return newRaw(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, qx, qy, qz, qw)
end

function CFrame.lookAt(at, target, up)
    up = up or Vector3.yAxis
    local back = (at - target).Unit
    if back.Magnitude == 0 then back = Vector3.zAxis end
    local right = up:Cross(back).Unit
    if right.Magnitude == 0 then right = Vector3.xAxis end
    local trueUp = back:Cross(right)
    return CFrame.fromMatrix(at, right, trueUp, back)
end

function CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ(rx, ry, rz)
    local qx = { axisq(1, 0, 0, rx) }
    local qy = { axisq(0, 1, 0, ry) }
    local qz = { axisq(0, 0, 1, rz) }
    local ax, ay, az, aw = qmul(qx[1], qx[2], qx[3], qx[4], qy[1], qy[2], qy[3], qy[4])
    ax, ay, az, aw = qmul(ax, ay, az, aw, qz[1], qz[2], qz[3], qz[4])
    return newRaw(0, 0, 0, ax, ay, az, aw)
end

CFrame.Angles = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ

function CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(rx, ry, rz)
    local qy = { axisq(0, 1, 0, ry) }
    local qx = { axisq(1, 0, 0, rx) }
    local qz = { axisq(0, 0, 1, rz) }
    local ax, ay, az, aw = qmul(qy[1], qy[2], qy[3], qy[4], qx[1], qx[2], qx[3], qx[4])
    ax, ay, az, aw = qmul(ax, ay, az, aw, qz[1], qz[2], qz[3], qz[4])
    return newRaw(0, 0, 0, ax, ay, az, aw)
end

CFrame.fromOrientation = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ

function CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, angle)
    local u = axis.Unit
    return newRaw(0, 0, 0, axisq(u.x, u.y, u.z, angle))
end

function CFrame.new(a, b, c, ...)
    if a == nil then
        return newRaw(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)
    end
    if type(a) == "table" and type(b) == "table" then
        return CFrame.lookAt(a, b, c)
    end
    if type(a) == "table" then
        return newRaw(a.x, a.y, a.z, 0, 0, 0, 1)
    end
    local rest = { ... }
    if #rest >= 9 then
        local qx, qy, qz, qw = matq(rest[1], rest[2], rest[3], rest[4], rest[5], rest[6], rest[7], rest[8], rest[9])
        return newRaw(a, b, c, qx, qy, qz, qw)
    end
    if #rest >= 4 then
        return newRaw(a, b, c, rest[1], rest[2], rest[3], rest[4])
    end
    return newRaw(a or 0, b or 0, c or 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)
end

function CFrame.__mul(a, b)
    if type(b) == "table" and b.qw ~= nil then
        local px, py, pz = qrot(a.qx, a.qy, a.qz, a.qw, b.x, b.y, b.z)
        local qx, qy, qz, qw = qmul(a.qx, a.qy, a.qz, a.qw, b.qx, b.qy, b.qz, b.qw)
        return newRaw(a.x + px, a.y + py, a.z + pz, qx, qy, qz, qw)
    end
    local px, py, pz = qrot(a.qx, a.qy, a.qz, a.qw, b.x, b.y, b.z)
    return Vector3.new(a.x + px, a.y + py, a.z + pz)
end

function CFrame.__add(a, v)
    return newRaw(a.x + v.x, a.y + v.y, a.z + v.z, a.qx, a.qy, a.qz, a.qw)
end

function CFrame.__sub(a, v)
    return newRaw(a.x - v.x, a.y - v.y, a.z - v.z, a.qx, a.qy, a.qz, a.qw)
end

function CFrame.__eq(a, b)
    return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y and a.z == b.z
        and a.qx == b.qx and a.qy == b.qy and a.qz == b.qz and a.qw == b.qw
end

function CFrame.__tostring(c)
    local r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22 = qmat(c.qx, c.qy, c.qz, c.qw)
    return string.format("%.3f, %.3f, %.3f, %.5f, %.5f, %.5f, %.5f, %.5f, %.5f, %.5f, %.5f, %.5f",
        c.x, c.y, c.z, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22)
end

function CFrame:Inverse()
    local ix, iy, iz, iw = -self.qx, -self.qy, -self.qz, self.qw
    local px, py, pz = qrot(ix, iy, iz, iw, -self.x, -self.y, -self.z)
    return newRaw(px, py, pz, ix, iy, iz, iw)
end

function CFrame:ToWorldSpace(cf)
    return self * cf
end

function CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cf)
    return self:Inverse() * cf
end

function CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(v)
    return self * v
end

function CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(v)
    return self:Inverse() * v
end

function CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(v)
    return Vector3.new(qrot(self.qx, self.qy, self.qz, self.qw, v.x, v.y, v.z))
end

function CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(v)
    return Vector3.new(qrot(-self.qx, -self.qy, -self.qz, self.qw, v.x, v.y, v.z))
end

function CFrame:GetComponents()
    local r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22 = qmat(self.qx, self.qy, self.qz, self.qw)
    return self.x, self.y, self.z, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22
end

CFrame.components = CFrame.GetComponents

function CFrame:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
    local r00, r01, r02, _, r11, r12, _, r21, r22 = qmat(self.qx, self.qy, self.qz, self.qw)
    local sy = math.max(-1, math.min(1, r02))
    local y = math.asin(sy)
    if math.abs(r02) < 0.99999 then
        return math.atan2(-r12, r22), y, math.atan2(-r01, r00)
    end
    return math.atan2(r21, r11), y, 0
end

CFrame.toEulerAnglesXYZ = CFrame.ToEulerAnglesXYZ

function CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    local _, _, r02, r10, r11, r12, _, _, r22 = qmat(self.qx, self.qy, self.qz, self.qw)
    local sx = math.max(-1, math.min(1, -r12))
    local x = math.asin(sx)
    if math.abs(r12) < 0.99999 then
        return x, math.atan2(r02, r22), math.atan2(r10, r11)
    end
    return x, math.atan2(r02, r22), 0
end

CFrame.toEulerAnglesYXZ = CFrame.ToEulerAnglesYXZ
CFrame.ToOrientation = CFrame.ToEulerAnglesYXZ

function CFrame:Lerp(goal, alpha)
    local ax, ay, az, aw = self.qx, self.qy, self.qz, self.qw
    local bx, by, bz, bw = goal.qx, goal.qy, goal.qz, goal.qw
    if ax * bx + ay * by + az * bz + aw * bw < 0 then
        bx, by, bz, bw = -bx, -by, -bz, -bw
    end
    return newRaw(
        self.x + (goal.x - self.x) * alpha,
        self.y + (goal.y - self.y) * alpha,
        self.z + (goal.z - self.z) * alpha,
        ax + (bx - ax) * alpha,
        ay + (by - ay) * alpha,
        az + (bz - az) * alpha,
        aw + (bw - aw) * alpha
    )
end

local cframe_fields = {
    Position = function(c) return Vector3.new(c.x, c.y, c.z) end,
    p = function(c) return Vector3.new(c.x, c.y, c.z) end,
    X = function(c) return c.x end,
    Y = function(c) return c.y end,
    Z = function(c) return c.z end,
    LookVector = function(c) return Vector3.new(qrot(c.qx, c.qy, c.qz, c.qw, 0, 0, -1)) end,
    RightVector = function(c) return Vector3.new(qrot(c.qx, c.qy, c.qz, c.qw, 1, 0, 0)) end,
    UpVector = function(c) return Vector3.new(qrot(c.qx, c.qy, c.qz, c.qw, 0, 1, 0)) end,
    XVector = function(c) return Vector3.new(qrot(c.qx, c.qy, c.qz, c.qw, 1, 0, 0)) end,
    YVector = function(c) return Vector3.new(qrot(c.qx, c.qy, c.qz, c.qw, 0, 1, 0)) end,
    ZVector = function(c) return Vector3.new(qrot(c.qx, c.qy, c.qz, c.qw, 0, 0, 1)) end,
    Rotation = function(c) return newRaw(0, 0, 0, c.qx, c.qy, c.qz, c.qw) end,
}

local cframe_methods = {}
for key, value in pairs(CFrame) do
    if type(value) == "function" then cframe_methods[key] = value end
end

function CFrame.__index(c, key)
    local field = cframe_fields[key]
    if field then return field(c) end
    return cframe_methods[key]
end

CFrame.identity = newRaw(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)

Enum = {}

local EnumItem = {}
EnumItem.__index = EnumItem
function EnumItem.__tostring(i) return "Enum." .. i.EnumType.Name .. "." .. i.Name end
function EnumItem.__eq(a, b) return a.Name == b.Name and a.EnumType == b.EnumType end

local function defineEnum(name, items)
    local et = { Name = name }
    local byName, list = {}, {}
    for _, pair in ipairs(items) do
        local item = setmetatable({ Name = pair[1], Value = pair[2], EnumType = et }, EnumItem)
        byName[pair[1]] = item
        list[#list + 1] = item
    end
    function et:GetEnumItems()
        local out = {}
        for i, v in ipairs(list) do out[i] = v end
        return out
    end
    function et:FromName(n) return byName[n] end
    function et:FromValue(v)
        for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Value == v then return it end end
    end
    setmetatable(et, {
        __index = function(_, k)
            local it = byName[k]
            if it then return it end
            error("'" .. tostring(k) .. "' is not a valid member of \"Enum." .. name .. "\"", 2)
        end,
        __tostring = function() return "Enum." .. name end,
    })
    Enum[name] = et
end

defineEnum("Material", {
    {"Smooth", 1}, {"Plastic", 2}, {"Wood", 3}, {"Metal", 4}, {"Grass", 5}, {"Ice", 6}, {"Paint", 7},
})
defineEnum("NormalId", {
    {"Right", 0}, {"Top", 1}, {"Back", 2}, {"Left", 3}, {"Bottom", 4}, {"Front", 5},
})

        error("'" .. tostring(k) .. "' is not a valid Enum", 2)
```

### VortexStudio_runtime_prelude.luau

```luau
local __schedule = __schedule
local __report = __report
local __fireServer = __fireServer

local MAX_HANDLERS = 512

local function suspended(co, first)
	if coroutine.status(co) ~= "suspended" then
		return false
	end
	if type(first) == "table" and first.__block then
		return true
	end
	local seconds = 0
	if type(first) == "table" and first.__wait then
		seconds = first.__wait
	end
	__schedule(co, seconds)
	return true
end

local function adopt(co, ok, first)
	if not ok then
		error(first, 0)
	end
	suspended(co, first)
	return co
end

local function adoptSafe(co, ok, first)
	if not ok then
		__report(tostring(first))
		return co
	end
	suspended(co, first)
	return co
end

local function bind(fn, ...)
	local args = table.pack(...)
	if args.n == 0 then
		return fn
	end
	return function()
		return fn(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	end
end

task = {}

function task.wait(seconds)
	return coroutine.yield({ __wait = seconds or 0 })
end

function task.spawn(fn, ...)
	local co = fn
	if type(fn) == "function" then
		co = coroutine.create(fn)
	end
	return adopt(co, coroutine.resume(co, ...))
end

function task.delay(seconds, fn, ...)
	local co = coroutine.create(bind(fn, ...))
	__schedule(co, seconds or 0)
	return co
end

function task.defer(fn, ...)
	return task.delay(0, fn, ...)
end

function wait(seconds)
	return task.wait(seconds)
end

function spawn(fn)
	return task.spawn(fn)
end

function delay(seconds, fn)
	return task.delay(seconds, fn)
end

Debris = {}

function Debris:AddItem(item, lifetime)
	if item == nil then
		return
	end
	task.delay(lifetime or 10, function()
		if type(item) == "table" and type(item.Destroy) == "function" then
			item:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

function Debris:SetMaxItems() end

local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

function Connection:Disconnect()
	if not self.Connected then
		return
	end
	self.Connected = false
	local handlers = self._signal._handlers
	for i, c in ipairs(handlers) do
		if c == self then
			table.remove(handlers, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

Connection.disconnect = Connection.Disconnect

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

function Signal.new(name)
	return setmetatable({ _name = name, _handlers = {}, _waiting = {} }, Signal)
end

function Signal:Connect(fn)
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		error("Connect expects a function", 2)
	end
	if #self._handlers >= MAX_HANDLERS then
		error(`signal "{self._name}" exceeded {MAX_HANDLERS} connections`, 2)
	end
	local conn = setmetatable({ Connected = true, _signal = self, _fn = fn }, Connection)
	table.insert(self._handlers, conn)
	return conn
end

Signal.connect = Signal.Connect

function Signal:Once(fn)
	local conn
	conn = self:Connect(function(...)
		conn:Disconnect()
		fn(...)
	end)
	return conn
end

function Signal:Wait()
	table.insert(self._waiting, coroutine.running())
	return coroutine.yield({ __block = true })
end

function Signal:Fire(...)
	local snapshot = {}
	for i, conn in ipairs(self._handlers) do
		snapshot[i] = conn
	end
	for _, conn in ipairs(snapshot) do
		if conn.Connected then
			local co = coroutine.create(conn._fn)
			adoptSafe(co, coroutine.resume(co, ...))
		end
	end

	local waiters = self._waiting
	if #waiters > 0 then
		self._waiting = {}
		for _, co in ipairs(waiters) do
			adoptSafe(co, coroutine.resume(co, ...))
		end
	end
end

Signal.fire = Signal.Fire

local registry = {}

function __signal(key)
	local existing = registry[key]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	local created = Signal.new(key)
	registry[key] = created
	return created
end

function __fire(key, ...)
	local existing = registry[key]
	if existing then
		existing:Fire(...)
	end
end

function __has(key)
	local existing = registry[key]
	return existing ~= nil and (#existing._handlers > 0 or #existing._waiting > 0)
end

function __promote(from, to)
	local moves = {}
	for key in pairs(registry) do
		local rest = key:match("^Changed%.(.+)$")
		if rest == from then
			moves[#moves + 1] = { key, "Changed." .. to }
		end
		local scope, prop = key:match("^PropChanged%.([^.]+)%.(.+)$")
		if scope == from then
			moves[#moves + 1] = { key, "PropChanged." .. to .. "." .. prop }
		end
		local ascope, aname = key:match("^AttrChanged%.([^.]+)%.(.+)$")
		if ascope == from then
			moves[#moves + 1] = { key, "AttrChanged." .. to .. "." .. aname }
		end
	end
	for _, m in ipairs(moves) do
		local src = registry[m[1]]
		if src then
			local dst = __signal(m[2])
			for _, h in ipairs(src._handlers) do
				dst._handlers[#dst._handlers + 1] = h
				h._signal = dst
			end
			for _, w in ipairs(src._waiting) do
				dst._waiting[#dst._waiting + 1] = w
			end
			registry[m[1]] = nil
		end
	end
end

RunService = {
	Heartbeat = __signal("RunService.Heartbeat"),
}

local function bounceOut(t)
	local n, d = 7.5625, 2.75
	if t < 1 / d then
		return n * t * t
	elseif t < 2 / d then
		t = t - 1.5 / d
		return n * t * t + 0.75
	elseif t < 2.5 / d then
		t = t - 2.25 / d
		return n * t * t + 0.9375
	else
		t = t - 2.625 / d
		return n * t * t + 0.984375
	end
end

local EASE_IN = {
	Linear = function(t) return t end,
	Sine = function(t) return 1 - math.cos(t * math.pi / 2) end,
	Quad = function(t) return t * t end,
	Cubic = function(t) return t * t * t end,
	Quart = function(t) return t * t * t * t end,
	Quint = function(t) return t * t * t * t * t end,
	Exponential = function(t) return t == 0 and 0 or 2 ^ (10 * (t - 1)) end,
	Circular = function(t) return 1 - math.sqrt(math.max(0, 1 - t * t)) end,
	Back = function(t)
		local c1 = 1.70158
		return (c1 + 1) * t * t * t - c1 * t * t
	end,
	Elastic = function(t)
		if t == 0 or t == 1 then return t end
		return -(2 ^ (10 * (t - 1))) * math.sin((t - 1.075) * (2 * math.pi) / 0.3)
	end,
	Bounce = function(t) return 1 - bounceOut(1 - t) end,
}

local function easeName(v)
	if type(v) == "table" and v.Name then return v.Name end
	if type(v) == "string" then return v end
	return nil
end

local function applyEasing(style, direction, t)
	local f = EASE_IN[easeName(style) or "Quad"] or EASE_IN.Quad
	local dir = easeName(direction) or "Out"
	if dir == "In" then
		return f(t)
	elseif dir == "InOut" then
		if t < 0.5 then return f(2 * t) / 2 end
		return 1 - f(2 - 2 * t) / 2
	else
		return 1 - f(1 - t)
	end
end

TweenInfo = {}

function TweenInfo.new(time, style, direction, repeatCount, reverses, delayTime)
	return {
		Time = time or 1,
		EasingStyle = style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		EasingDirection = direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
		RepeatCount = repeatCount or 0,
		Reverses = reverses or false,
		DelayTime = delayTime or 0,
	}
end

local function lerpValue(a, b, t)
	if type(a) == "number" then
		return a + (b - a) * t
	end
	if type(a) == "table" and type(a.Lerp) == "function" then
		return a:Lerp(b, t)
	end
	return t < 1 and a or b
end

local tweenActive = {}
local MAX_TWEENS = 256

local Tween = {}
Tween.__index = Tween

function Tween:Play()
	if self.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
		return
	end
	if self.PlaybackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Paused then
		self._elapsed = 0
		self._start = {}
		for prop in pairs(self._goals) do
			self._start[prop] = self.Instance[prop]
		end
	end
	self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Playing
	for _, e in ipairs(tweenActive) do
		if e == self then return end
	end
	if #tweenActive >= MAX_TWEENS then
		error(`more than {MAX_TWEENS} tweens playing at once`, 2)
	end
	tweenActive[#tweenActive + 1] = self
end

local function removeTween(self)
	for i, e in ipairs(tweenActive) do
		if e == self then
			table.remove(tweenActive, i)
			return
		end
	end
end

function Tween:Pause()
	if self.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
		self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Paused
	end
end

function Tween:Cancel()
	removeTween(self)
	self._elapsed = 0
	self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled
	self.Completed:Fire(Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled)
end

local function sampleTween(self)
	local d = self._info.Time
	if d <= 0 then return 1, true end
	local elapsed = self._elapsed - self._info.DelayTime
	local seg = self._info.Reverses and (2 * d) or d
	local total = self._info.RepeatCount < 0 and math.huge
		or seg * (self._info.RepeatCount + 1)
	if elapsed >= total then
		return (self._info.Reverses and 0 or 1), true
	end
	local within = elapsed % seg
	if self._info.Reverses and within > d then
		return 1 - (within - d) / d, false
	end
	return math.min(within / d, 1), false
end

local function stepTweens(dt)
	local snapshot = {}
	for i, e in ipairs(tweenActive) do snapshot[i] = e end
	for _, tw in ipairs(snapshot) do
		if tw.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
			if tw.Instance.Parent == nil then
				removeTween(tw)
			else
				tw._elapsed = tw._elapsed + dt
				if tw._elapsed >= tw._info.DelayTime then
					local alpha, done = sampleTween(tw)
					local eased = applyEasing(tw._info.EasingStyle, tw._info.EasingDirection, alpha)
					for prop, goal in pairs(tw._goals) do
						pcall(function()
							tw.Instance[prop] = lerpValue(tw._start[prop], goal, eased)
						end)
					end
					if done then
						removeTween(tw)
						tw.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
						tw.Completed:Fire(Enum.PlaybackState.Completed)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if #tweenActive > 0 then
		stepTweens(dt or 0)
	end
end)

TweenService = {}

function TweenService:Create(m_7123a699d7, info, goals)
	if type(m_7123a699d7) ~= "table" then
		error("TweenService:Create expects an Instance", 2)
	end
	if type(goals) ~= "table" then
		error("TweenService:Create expects a table of properties", 2)
	end
	info = info or TweenInfo.new()
	return setmetatable({
		Instance = m_7123a699d7,
		PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Begin,
		Completed = Signal.new("Tween.Completed"),
		_info = {
			Time = info.Time or 1,
			EasingStyle = info.EasingStyle,
			EasingDirection = info.EasingDirection,
			RepeatCount = info.RepeatCount or 0,
			Reverses = info.Reverses or false,
			DelayTime = info.DelayTime or 0,
		},
		_goals = goals,
		_start = {},
		_elapsed = 0,
	}, Tween)
end

function FireServer(channel, ...)
	__fireServer(channel, ...)
end

function OnRemoteEvent(channel, fn)
	return __signal("RemoteEvent." .. channel):Connect(fn)
end

__serverInvokeHandlers = {}

function __makeInvokeServer(queue)
	return function(_, ...)
		local id = queue(...)
		local ok, a, b, c, d, e, f, g = __signal("Invoke." .. id):Wait()
		registry["Invoke." .. id] = nil
		if not ok then
			error(a, 0)
		end
		return a, b, c, d, e, f, g
	end
end

function __runServerInvoke(key, ...)
	local fn = __serverInvokeHandlers[key]
	if not fn then
		return
	end
	return pcall(fn, ...)
end
```
